title: NOC copilot ML dataset row
description: One row per (device, entity, entity_type, ts-bucket) in the joined labeled Parquet emitted by export.py. Metric columns are nullable per entity_type. Enforced by check_dataset.py.

ts.description: UTC bucket start. Parquet type is timestamp[us, tz=UTC]; this schema validates the JSON projection, where it is ISO-8601 …Z text

vrf.description: VRF on VRF-scoped interface rows; on tunnel rows the '+'-joined SET of VRFs riding that tunnel (a tunnel is shared); null on physical interfaces and device rows

entity.description: interface name, tunnel id, or the device name on entity_type=device rows

flow_bytes.description: device-wide, carried on the entity_type=device row only

flow_packets.description: device-wide, carried on the entity_type=device row only

scenario_id.description: PRIMARY (highest-severity) episode; full set in scenario_ids

severity.description: ordinal magnitude 0.33/0.66/1.0 of the primary episode; null when the injector ignores severity. String form in severity_label

lead_time_s.description: primary episode's lead; drawn per episode from faults/leadpriors.py

time_to_impact_s.description: one entry per concurrent episode, index-aligned with the other list columns; element 0 is the primary

fault_types.description: every episode overlapping this row; element 0 is the primary

scenario_ids.description: the train/test split key -- unique per injection

impact_methods.description: how each episode's t_impact was established: vm_threshold | ramp_derived | modelled_fallback | probe_unavailable | modelled

n_concurrent.description: length of the list columns; 0 on healthy rows

severity_label.description: primary episode's severity as a string
